gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: The collection uses simulator geometry only in a TRAIN teacher and has no runtime student or official-site rule validation.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: All 24 independent TRAIN cells had recovery labels. Registered pulse-to-opposite-sign floors of 20 cells per direction passed 24/24 left and 22/24 right; 72 episodes, 917 finite samples, 48 matching NPZ hashes and zero invalid actions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Only 2/24 unpulsed control cells had natural recovery labels, below the preregistered minimum four. The data coverage gate for pixel-student fitting therefore fails; teacher-only laps are not candidate scores.
